newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Far East Bank allocates US$100 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Far East Bank allocates US$100 mln FRCD.

text.p: Far East Bank and Trust Co's US$100 million multiple-series floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been allocated, the lead managers said.
The certificates were offered in three series with maturities of one, four and five years. Banks were required to participate in each series on a pro-rata basis.
For co-lead managers, the weighted average all-in yield is approximately 89.86 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate for an average life of 3.45 years.
Arrangers and lead managers Citicorp International and Sakura Finance Asia each committed to US$20.5 million.
Expanded lead managers, with US$10 million each, were Dresdner (South East Asia), First Commercial Bank and Kookmin Bank.
Co-lead managers, with US$3 million each, are Development Bank of Singapore, Landesbank Pheinland-Pfalz Gorozentrale and Union Bank of Taiwan.
Signing is scheduled for October 30, 1996 in Hong Kong. The payment date is November 7, 1996.
